articles.summary: Artificial intelligence has been a theme at technology conferences for years. At the Jefferies Private Growth Conference in Santa Monica this April however, it was the reality shaping nearly every conversation. Few are better positioned to assess that shift than Brett Rochkind, Managing Partner at SoftBank Investment Advisers, whose firm has placed one of the largest single bets in venture history on the AI era.
articles.title: AI Is Disrupting the Entire Economy, Not Just the Tech Stack – Brett Rochkind, SoftBank Investment Advisers

articles.summary: Consider this fact: Last year, even as fundraising across private markets fell by roughly 17 percent, co-investment fundraising rose by more than 17 percent year over year to about $27 billion.
articles.title: Private Equity’s New Liquidity Engine: Rapid Growth in Co-Investment Secondary Volume Is Serving Both Sellers and Buyers Well

articles.summary: Five years ago, it was a sliver of the broader secondaries business — a tool sponsors primarily used to manage liquidity for challenged assets and/or funds. Now investors are increasingly seeking trophy assets in the secondary market and through continuation vehicles (CV), which is just one reason why Jefferies expects global transaction volume to reach $30 billion, up from roughly $20 billion in 2025.
articles.title: Infrastructure Secondaries Hit Their Stride: A Once-Niche Corner of the Market Could Reach $30 Billion in 2026

articles.summary: Nestled at the edge of Germany's Black Forest, Baden-Baden has long been known as one of Europe's most elegant destinations. The UNESCO-listed spa town combines more than 2,000 years of history with a reputation for bringing together influential leaders, investors, and decision-makers in a setting designed for meaningful conversations.
articles.title: Germany, Switzerland and Europe’s Next Investment Cycle: Five Themes to Watch Ahead of the Jefferies German and Swiss Conference
